Visible example: capacity 2 with values [4,7,9,1] returns [-1,-1,4,7].

reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<Integer> ringBufferTrace(int capacity,List<Integer> values){if(capacity<=0)return null;var q=new ArrayDeque<Integer>();var o=new ArrayList<Integer>();for(int v:values){if(v==-1)return null;o.add(q.size()==capacity?q.removeFirst():-1);q.addLast(v);}return o;}}
